description: Time Machine Platform for Healthcare - Letting doctors(Hospitals, Rehabilitations), patients, and insurers instantly access a Unified global medical history, with Ai agents powering workflows that reduce the analysis time, provides deep insights and complete detailed analysis of the patient.
problem_statement: Understanding patients medical history is more tough for doctors when the patient age gets old. Need more attention to the complete medical background with many diseases. With Medsyn Ai, we are creating a platform for the Doctors to get deep understanding of patients health condition, previous medications, diet and everything. For Insurers Medsyn Ai acts as a tool to process the Claims faster with detailed medical insights. Without Medsyn Ai, it takes days and weeks to understand the medical history and provide care. Also to insurers it's tough to manually check with hospitals and previous medical claims and process takes weeks-months.
